overview_description.description:
Schoolvoice is an interactive communication and engagement platform designed to enhance the interaction between schools and parents. 
It serves as a bridge to foster seamless and effective communication.
Schoolvoice is meticulously designed around the user experience of both parents and schools, taking into account the challenges both parties often encounter with existing school communication systems.

about_short_description.short_description: Schoolvoice is an interactive communication and engagement platform designed to enhance interaction between schools and parents.

product.name: Schoolvoice Communication Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform enabling schools to send unlimited messages to parents with predefined responses for efficient communication and engagement.

product.name: School Admin Web Portal
product.description: A web-based portal for school administrators and teachers to manage communications, student data, and generate reports.

product.name: Schoolvoice Mobile App for Parents
product.description: A mobile app for parents to receive school messages, respond with predefined replies, and stay updated on their child's school activities.

product.name: Actionable Messages Feature
product.description: A messaging feature that allows schools to send messages with predefined response options for parents to reply with a single tap.

product.name: Instant Chat (Private Messaging)
product.description: A private messaging feature that enables direct, one-on-one communication between teachers and parents.

product.name: Stories Feature
product.description: A feature for teachers to share class activities, photos, and videos with parents to keep them informed and engaged.
